canonicalModel.materialSource: PcbSubstrateProperties in PcbStructuralDeflectionEngine.ts (FR4 default Young's Modulus E=24 GPa, nu=0.14, rho=1850 kg/m^3)

PcbStructuralDeflectionEngine.method: 1D Euler-Bernoulli beam formula applied to 2D board with I = W*h^3/12
gaps: Ignores mountingType parameter ('FOUR_CORNERS_SUPPORTED' vs 'FOUR_EDGES_CLAMPED'); produces identical output regardless of BC
Does not account for Poisson's ratio (nu) in plate flexural rigidity D = E*h^3 / (12*(1-nu^2))
Does not construct or solve a discrete linear system [K]{u} = {F}
No spatial deflection field w(x,y) or curvature field
No stress tensor recovery (sigma_xx, sigma_yy, tau_xy, sigma_vonMises)
No algebraic residual computation r = Ku - f
No static reaction force equilibrium check sum(R_z) = F_applied
No support for discrete component point masses at placement coordinates (x,y)
No mesh refinement or spatial convergence capability

StructuralFemEngine.method: Closed-form 1D cantilever beam formula wrapped in fake FEM mesh loop
gaps: Claims to be a matrix stiffness solver [K]{u}={F} but does not assemble any stiffness matrix
Not connected to PCB canonical model or multi-domain verification

MechanicsEngine.method: Lumped scalar formulas (F=ma, tau=F*r, sigma=F/A, epsilon=sigma/E)
gaps: No structural discretization or continuum mechanics formulation

declaredScope: 2D Kirchhoff-Love Thin Plate Bending Formulation with Discrete Matrix Stiffness Assembly [K]{w} = {F}, Point/Distributed Loads, Multilayer Plate Rigidity, Stress Tensor Recovery, Reaction Equilibrium, and Monotonic Mesh Refinement.
